svg.title: Explore & Community — User Flowchart
svg.text: YouCam Muse Web — desktop 1440 (D8) · matches spec v1, 2026-09-01
amber = decision · blue = system response · coral = human hand-off · green = success / resolved · red = error state

g.text: A hub, not a sequence — so this is drawn as one band per path rather than one graph.
Every route here is PUBLIC. The sign-in gate sits at the ACTION (Create / Like), never on the route.
Every rail, grid and profile is a fixed seed array in array order: nothing is ranked, refreshed or personalised.
Public. Hero + two create cards + three seed rails ·
The album art previews; the row TITLE navigates · P1-S5
Each appears only while the row can scroll that way ·
Sign-in modal — opens at the ACTION
Every Create and every Like on this surface · P1-S7, P1-S8
Never gated. S9 owns its rules · P1-S6
Two sections: Top Picks (3) + Newly Released (11) · P2-S1
ALL 14 seed items render — no cap
Counted live. A bigger backlist renders in full · P2-S1
A card is a real, locale-prefixed link
So middle-click and copy-link reach it too · P2-S2, P2-S3
Every MV card anywhere lands there · P2-S2
Top Picks rail + All and the nine genre tabs · P3-S1
A tab filters the LIST only
What is playing never changes or restarts · P3-S2
Album art → previews in the bottom bar
No navigation; real audio, no free-account cap · P3-S3
At ≥768px. S1 owns that screen · P3-S4 (AC-EXP-03)
Genre, mood, title, lyrics. Gated · P3-S5 (AC-EXP-02)
Stage in the item’s own 3:4 or 4:3; floating meta; transport ·
The eight hero MVs only, against the video’s own rect ·
Commits to the next / previous MV
The URL is REPLACED, not pushed; no reload · P4-S5
Also the only outcome for an id outside the feed · P4-S6,
The same two sections below the player
Like is GATED · Share is NOT
Both act at the press; Like is session-local · P4-S8, P4-S9
mvType, prompt, matched song, title. S2 owns it · P4-S10
Part 5 — Play a community song · P5
The SAME screen as /explore/songs — the id only
And nothing marks which song the link named (Q-04) ·
Play opens the bar on that track
On the linked song, not the list’s first row · P5-S2
A creator id swaps the whole list
Eight creator tracks, and NO tab is active · P5-S3 (EXP-09)
Part 6 — The creator profile, and the states nothing else reaches · P6
Name + Plays / Likes + Music Videos / Songs tabs. No
No overflow menu at all, and no Report / Block · P6-S2
First slot: Edit MV on an MV, Create MV on a song · P6-S4, P6-S5
The subtitle and the create CTA only on your OWN page · P6-S6,
the demo switch — the only way in
On EITHER player; never a silent fallback · P4-S11, P5-S4
The Curation PRD’s whole layer — UNBUILT. No edge on
